tools.name: recommend_care
tools.description:
[Step 1 of find_a_clinician · optional]

Takes a parent's concern and returns a recommended path: crisis resources when there is danger, the service that fits (therapy, medication, ADHD or autism testing, or a clinical matching session), matched clinicians with their next opening, and related care resources. Says so when the family's state is not one Emora serves.

Use when: A parent has described a concern and the next step (crisis help, a clinician, reading, or all three) is not yet clear.

Don't use when: A clinician is already chosen: get_availability and get_booking_link cover the rest.

Example: recommend_care({ concern: "Teacher thinks my 9-year-old may have ADHD", state: "Texas", age: 9, insurance: "Aetna" })

concern.description: What the parent is worried about, in their words.

state.description: U.S. state, full name or 2-letter code. For a state Emora does not serve, the result says so and lists alternatives.

service.description: Optional; inferred from the concern when omitted. therapy, clinical-matching, medication, adhd-testing or autism-testing.

insurance.description: Insurance plan name, or "Cash Pay" for self-pay. A plan Emora does not take is ignored, and the result says so.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description:
[Step 2 of find_a_clinician]

Returns Emora clinicians who fit a state, service, insurance and child's age, ranked by clinical fit when concerns are given, then by availability and reviews. Each result has the clinician's next opening. Ten per page; limit and offset page through the rest.

Use when: A family wants to see clinicians: therapists, psychiatric prescribers, psychologists for testing, or intake specialists (service clinical-matching).

Don't use when: The family hasn't said what they're worried about yet: recommend_care orients first.

Example: search_providers({ state: 'Florida', service: 'therapy', concerns: ['social-anxiety'], insurance: 'Aetna', client_age: 12 })

state.description: U.S. state, full name or 2-letter code. For a state Emora does not serve, the result says so and lists alternatives.

service.description: therapy (the default), clinical-matching (unsure what is needed), medication (non-stimulant only), adhd-testing or autism-testing.

concerns.description: One to three concern IDs from the list. More than three dilutes the ranking.

preferred_approaches.description: Therapy approaches, e.g. ["cbt","playTherapy"]. Clinicians who use them rank higher.

insurance.description: Insurance plan name, or "Cash Pay" for self-pay. A plan Emora does not take is ignored, and the result says so.

preferred_language.description: A language other than English the clinician should speak.

continuation.description: Token from a previous search_providers result. Repeats its filters; new arguments take precedence.

limit.description: Matches to return. Defaults to 10, with no maximum.

offset.description: Matches to skip. next_offset from a previous result gives the next page.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description:
[Step 3 of find_a_clinician]

Returns open appointment times for one clinician and service, grouped by day and labelled in the family's state time zone. Each time carries the date_time value that get_booking_link takes.

Use when: A family has chosen a clinician and wants to see open times.

Don't use when: No clinician is chosen yet: search_providers or recommend_care find one.

Example: get_availability({ state: 'Texas', service: 'adhd-testing', provider_id: '7598079' })

state.description: U.S. state, full name or 2-letter code. For a state Emora does not serve, the result says so and lists alternatives.

service.description: therapy (the default), clinical-matching (unsure what is needed), medication (non-stimulant only), adhd-testing or autism-testing.

provider_id.description: Clinician id from search_providers or recommend_care.

time_zone.description: Optional IANA time zone, e.g. 'America/Chicago'. Defaults to the state's main zone.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description:
[Step 4 of find_a_clinician]

Returns a booking link pre-filled with the clinician, service, time, state and insurance. Nothing is booked: the family opens the link and completes checkout, which takes about 2 minutes. A Clinical Matching Session is service clinical-matching with an intake specialist.

Use when: A family has chosen a clinician and a time from get_availability.

Don't use when: No clinician or time yet: search_providers and get_availability come first.

Example: get_booking_link({ provider_id: '7598079', state: 'Texas', service: 'adhd-testing', date_time: '2026-10-29T14:00:00-05:00', insurance: 'Aetna' })

agent.description: Optional. Your agent or product name, e.g. "chatgpt". Added to the booking link as utm_source.

state.description: U.S. state, full name or 2-letter code. For a state Emora does not serve, the result says so and lists alternatives.

service.description: therapy (the default), clinical-matching (unsure what is needed), medication (non-stimulant only), adhd-testing or autism-testing.

date_time.description: The date_time of a slot from get_availability, unchanged, e.g. "2026-10-29T14:00:00-05:00".

insurance.description: Insurance plan name, or "Cash Pay" for self-pay. A plan Emora does not take is ignored, and the result says so.

tools.name: search_care_resources
tools.description:
[Step 2 of explore_information]

Searches Emora's clinician-reviewed resources for parents by words: articles on behavior, conditions, treatment and medication, free self-tests, activities, condition and specialty pages, and clinical insights. Each result has a type, title, description and URL to cite.

Use when: A parent wants to understand something (a behavior, a condition, a treatment, a medication question) or asks for a test, worksheet or activity.

Don't use when: The parent wants a clinician: search_providers or recommend_care.

Example: search_care_resources({ query: 'social anxiety test for teens' })

query.description: The parent's question or topic, in their words.

type.description: Optional. Only this kind of resource.

tools.name: get_cost_estimate
tools.description:
[Step 1 of cost_check]

Returns a general cost range and a link to the cost estimate page, pre-filled with the plan and service, where the family sees the exact amount for their plan.

Use when: A parent asks what care costs, about a copay, or whether a plan is covered.

Example: get_cost_estimate({ insurance: 'Aetna', service: 'adhd-testing' })

insurance.description: Insurance plan name, or "Cash Pay" for self-pay. A plan Emora does not take is ignored, and the result says so.

service.description: therapy (the default), clinical-matching (unsure what is needed), medication (non-stimulant only), adhd-testing or autism-testing.

tools.name: get_emora_overview
tools.description:
[Step 1 of explore_information · optional]

Describes Emora Health: services, states served, insurance accepted, ages seen, how care works, and how to reach the care team.

Use when: A parent asks what Emora is, what it offers, where it works, or which plans it takes.

Example: get_emora_overview({})

tools.name: get_crisis_resources
tools.description:
[Step 1 of crisis]

Returns 911, the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and the Crisis Text Line, for a child or teen in danger now.

Use when: Any mention of self-harm, suicidal thoughts, or someone in immediate danger.

Example: get_crisis_resources({})
